text: Standing here, I feel a sense of potential and anticipation. The first image, looking into a glass-walled meeting room, evokes thoughts about transparency, connection, and the fleeting nature of collaboration—spaces ready for ideas yet empty for now. Moving into the R+D display in the second image, I'm surrounded by the symbols of human curiosity and innovation. Each detail urges reflection on progress, on how environments shape thought and invention. I sense excitement yet also the silent pressure of expectation, as though novel ideas are both welcome and demanded here. I feel contemplative, alert to possibility, aware of being both observer and participant in an ongoing experiment of knowledge and discovery.
